image_description: A close-up view of a circular, gold-rimmed aneroid barometer. The face is white with black markings and text. It features a central decorative element resembling a stylized sun or compass rose in gold and black. There are two hands: a black indicator hand and a gold reference hand. The dial contains numerical scales and text labels for weather conditions (e.g., 'Stormy', 'Rain', 'Change', 'Fair', 'Dry'). The glass cover reflects light, indicating a convex surface.
